examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{根幹|こんかん}に{触|ふ}れる。
examples.english: To get to the root of the problem.

examples.japanese: これは{会社|かいしゃ}の{経営|けいえい}の{根幹|こんかん}に{関|かか}わる{問題|もんだい}だ。
examples.english: This is an issue that affects the core of the company's management.

examples.japanese: {教育|きょういく}の{根幹|こんかん}を{成|な}すのは{家庭|かてい}での{躾|しつけ}だ。
examples.english: Home discipline forms the foundation of education.

notes:
{根幹|こんかん} combines {根|こん/ね} (root) + {幹|かん/みき} (trunk), referring to the essential foundation or core of something.

Common expressions:
- {根幹|こんかん}を{成|な}す (to form the basis of)
- {根幹|こんかん}に{関|かか}わる (to concern the fundamentals)
- {根幹|こんかん}を{揺|ゆ}るがす (to shake the foundations)
- {根幹|こんかん}{部分|ぶぶん} (core part)

Used in formal or written contexts when discussing fundamental aspects of systems, organizations, or concepts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {根本|こんぽん} (root, fundamental - slightly more common)
- {基盤|きばん} (foundation, base)
- {核心|かくしん} (core, heart of the matter)
